title: The Ethical Risks of Analyzing Crisis Events on Social Media with Machine Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis and literature review evaluating how tweet-density-based crisis event detection systems disproportionately favor wealthier areas.
Literature review evaluating how hate speech detectors and sentiment classifiers overestimate toxicity in African-American Vernacular English.
Literature review assessing how Named-Entity Recognition (NER) systems used in crisis geoparsing pipelines exhibit lower accuracy for female entities.
Conceptual evaluation of the scarcity of NLP models and crisis corpora for non-English and low-resource languages, negatively impacting vulnerable populations.
Analysis of platform demographics highlighting how social media data heavily overrepresents users from specific wealthy nations (e.g., US and Japan), skewing crisis perception.
